pyproject.toml.text:
[build-system]
requires = [
    "scikit-build-core>=0.12,<0.13",
    "torch==2.10.0",
]
build-backend = "scikit_build_core.build"

[project]
name = "rhinoforge"
version = "1.0.0"
authors = [{name = "HUIXI-AI"}]
description = "PyTorch inference backend and model deployment toolkit for the Rhino Processing Unit"
readme = "README.md"
license = {file = "LICENSE"}
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"
keywords = ["pytorch", "rpu", "inference", "transformers", "vla"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: Apache Software License",
    "Operating System :: POSIX :: Linux",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Artificial Intelligence",
]
dependencies = [
    "accelerate>=1.1.0,<2",
    "huggingface-hub>=1.3,<2",
    "numpy>=2.0,<2.3",
    "safetensors>=0.4",
    "torch==2.10.0",
    "transformers==5.5.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
vision = [
    "pillow>=11",
    "torchvision==0.25.0",
]
vla = [
    "diffusers==0.38.0",
    "lerobot==0.6.1",
    "omegaconf>=2.3,<3",
    "pillow>=11",
    "pyyaml>=6",
    "scipy>=1.15,<2",
    "torchvision==0.25.0",
]
dev = [
    "build>=1.2",
    "pytest>=8",
]

[tool.scikit-build]
wheel.packages = ["python/rpu_backend"]
build.verbose = true
cmake.build-type = "Release"
build.tool-args = ["-j24"]
install.strip = true
wheel.exclude = [
    "tests/**",
    "**/tests/**",
    "debug/**",
    "**/debug/**",
    "**/*.pyc",
    "**/*.bak*",
    "**/*.log",
]
wheel.license-files = ["LICENSE", "NOTICE", "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["python"]
filterwarnings = ["error::pytest.PytestReturnNotNoneWarning"]
